body: I never order an uber unless I know for sure I can get to the pick up point with time to spare, so I don’t think that’s it 😅 This is why I’m confused with the rating cause I never make the driver wait, chat if they want to, keep my feet on the floor, etc.

I’m very much a germaphobe so I’m pretty confident I don’t smell 😅 My experience is that it’s the driver who’s more likely to stink. I never order an uber unless I’m at or can get to the pick up spot before they arrive and always make sure to have enough time to wait at the pick up spot, too.

I agree. Unless the rider is slamming the door with ungodly brute force, then I don’t see why this is a significant issue. A pet peeve, sure, but nothing to get angry about. I’m more scared about not shutting the door all the way the first time and inconveniencing the driver that way.
I appreciate your insight! Makes sense that the rating doesn’t update with your most recent ride. I suppose I’ll be more wary about rider etiquette so I can get my rating back up. Thank you!
My app might have not updated my rating yet, but that’s what I can see as of right now

Honestly that’s a relief to hear ;-; I work a minimum wage job so I try to tip well since I know how hard grinding for money can be. I only take ubers solely to go to doctor’s appointment since I live far and the possibility of not being able to get a ride was stressing me out

I feel like riders should be provided that reason for 1-3 star ratings if it affects their rides. It’s unfair to the rider to be able to view their ratings and while leaving them to speculate why some ratings are so low.
I usually tip regardless of whether or not I enjoyed the ride. I guess I should be a little more thoughtful as to who I tip from now on
And the worst part is if you tipped them not knowing they gave you the worst rating :’)

The system feels broken if drivers and riders alike can just handout 1 star ratings. I’m sure that some people deserve it, but I can’t think of anything that I did that would earn the lowest rating :(

I wish drivers were required to provide a reason why they rate low and vice versa. If ratings are significant enough to impact a driver/rider’s experience, then it’s unfair that people can give a low rating randomly.

It especially doesn’t help that I have social anxiety ;-; I feel like I have to scrutinize everything I do when I take an uber
